# NoCollisionConstraint

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("NoCollisionConstraint")`

Two parts that pass through each other, and collide with everything else as they did. What a collision group cannot say: a group is every part in it against every part in another, and this is one part against one. A thing being carried and the one carrying it; a door and its frame.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the two pass through each other. Off, they collide again. |
| `Part0` | `BasePart?` | — | read/write | One of the two. |
| `Part1` | `BasePart?` | — | read/write | The other. |
